title: 倫敦千禧巨蛋屋蓋
subcategoryTitle: 地標建築與大跨度屋蓋
summary: 千禧巨蛋並非結構意義上的穹頂，而是由 12 支約 100 m 高的桅桿以吊索與拉索撐起的穹形索網，上覆 PTFE 塗覆玻璃纖維膜，整個屋頂比室內空氣還輕。課程從索網與桅桿的傳力、輕屋蓋的荷載反轉出發，處理膜材選擇、索夾與吊索節點、地面組裝後絞升索網、索長精度與預張力，再談風洞試驗的雷諾數問題、索力現場量測、2022 年風暴後的膜片更換，以及改建為 The O2 時的荷載管理。
summaryEn: The Millennium Dome is not a dome in the structural sense but a dome-shaped cable net held up by hanger and tie-down cables from 12 masts about 100 m high and clad in PTFE-coated glass-fibre fabric, the whole roof weighing less than the air inside. The course starts from the load path of net and masts and load reversal on a lightweight roof, then covers fabric choice, clamps and hanger nodes, winching the ground-assembled net, cable-length accuracy and pretension, Reynolds-number issues in wind-tunnel tests, field measurement of cable forces, panel replacement after the 2022 storm and load control during conversion to The O2.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統」與「輕屋蓋的荷載反轉：風吸力控制」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "A dome that is not a dome: net and mast system" and "Load reversal on a light roof: wind uplift governs": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: A dome that is not a dome: net and mast system: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「徑向索網與 12 支桅桿」如何影響倫敦千禧巨蛋屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Radial net and 12 masts” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millennium Dome roof”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 千禧巨蛋的屋面由徑向布置的鋼索網構成，屋面劃分為 72 個區段，索網在中段由 12 支桅桿頂端垂下的吊索提起，外緣則以壓制索與周邊鋼筋混凝土環梁固定。索網只能受拉，靠曲率與預張力抵抗面外荷載；桅桿則把吊索拉力轉成軸壓傳到基礎，並以拉索平衡。與混凝土或鋼構穹頂不同，這種屋蓋沒有受壓殼面，形狀完全由索長、吊點位置與預張力決定，所以結構重量極輕，卻對荷載方向變化非常敏感。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「徑向索網與 12 支桅桿」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Millennium Dome roof is a cable net laid out radially and divided into 72 segments; in its middle zone the net is lifted by hanger cables from the tops of 12 masts, and at its edge it is held by tie-down cables and a perimeter reinforced-concrete ring beam. The net works only in tension, resisting out-of-plane load through curvature and pretension, while the masts turn hanger forces into axial compression delivered to their foundations and balanced by stays. Unlike a concrete or steel dome there is no compression shell; the shape is set entirely by cable lengths, hanger positions and pretension, so the structure is extremely light yet very sensitive to changes in load direction. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Radial net and 12 masts” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：72 個區段平分圓周，半徑 r 處的徑向索間距 s = 2πr/72：r = 50 m 時約 4.4 m，r = 160 m 時約 14.0 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 72 segments sharing the circumference, radial cable spacing at radius r is s = 2πr/72: about 4.4 m at r = 50 m and about 14.0 m at r = 160 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「千禧巨蛋是一個由鋼骨撐起的半球形穹頂。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The Millennium Dome is a hemispherical dome held up by a steel frame." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「徑向索網與 12 支桅桿」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Radial net and 12 masts”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統
knowledge.titleEn: A dome that is not a dome: net and mast system
knowledge.text: 千禧巨蛋的屋面由徑向布置的鋼索網構成，屋面劃分為 72 個區段，索網在中段由 12 支桅桿頂端垂下的吊索提起，外緣則以壓制索與周邊鋼筋混凝土環梁固定。索網只能受拉，靠曲率與預張力抵抗面外荷載；桅桿則把吊索拉力轉成軸壓傳到基礎，並以拉索平衡。
knowledge.textEn: The Millennium Dome roof is a cable net laid out radially and divided into 72 segments; in its middle zone the net is lifted by hanger cables from the tops of 12 masts, and at its edge it is held by tie-down cables and a perimeter reinforced-concrete ring beam. The net works only in tension, resisting out-of-plane load through curvature and pretension, while the masts turn hanger forces into axial compression delivered to their foundations and balanced by stays.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：千禧巨蛋是一個由鋼骨撐起的半球形穹頂。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The Millennium Dome is a hemispherical dome held up by a steel frame. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「倫敦千禧巨蛋屋蓋」的「不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統：機制與傳力路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出載重來源、構件、接點與支承的傳力邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「高樓模型整合室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與幾何版本、支承條件、荷載方向與獨立位移紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “A dome that is not a dome: net and mast system: mechanism and load path” in “Millennium Dome roof”. Draw the load, member, connection and support load paths; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Tower model integration room” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for geometry revision, supports, load direction and independent displacement records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "A dome that is not a dome: net and mast system" is correct?
options: 千禧巨蛋是一個由鋼骨撐起的半球形穹頂。
千禧巨蛋的屋面由徑向布置的鋼索網構成，屋面劃分為 72 個區段，索網在中段由 12 支桅桿頂端垂下的吊索提起，外緣則以壓制索與周邊鋼筋混凝土環梁固定。
屋頂越輕越安全，因為需要承擔的荷載越少。
optionsEn: The Millennium Dome is a hemispherical dome held up by a steel frame.
The Millennium Dome roof is a cable net laid out radially and divided into 72 segments.
The lighter a roof the safer it is, because it has less load to carry.
quiz.explanation: 千禧巨蛋的屋面由徑向布置的鋼索網構成，屋面劃分為 72 個區段，索網在中段由 12 支桅桿頂端垂下的吊索提起，外緣則以壓制索與周邊鋼筋混凝土環梁固定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Millennium Dome roof is a cable net laid out radially and divided into 72 segments; in its middle zone the net is lifted by hanger cables from the tops of 12 masts, and at its edge it is held by tie-down cables and a perimeter reinforced-concrete ring beam. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統：定量估算
steps.titleEn: A dome that is not a dome: net and mast system: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「徑向索網與 12 支桅桿」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Radial net and 12 masts” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：72 個區段平分圓周，半徑 r 處的徑向索間距 s = 2πr/72：r = 50 m 時約 4.4 m，r = 160 m 時約 14.0 m。若外緣一段徑向索受荷寬 14 m、荷載 0.6 kPa，w = 8.4 kN/m，吊點間跨距 L = 25 m、垂度 f = 1.0 m，水平張力 H = wL²/(8f) = 8.4×25²/8 ≈ 656 kN。荷載、跨距與垂度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 72 segments sharing the circumference, radial cable spacing at radius r is s = 2πr/72: about 4.4 m at r = 50 m and about 14.0 m at r = 160 m. If an outer radial cable carries a 14 m width at 0.6 kPa, w = 8.4 kN/m; with a span of L = 25 m between hanger points and sag f = 1.0 m, the horizontal tension is H = wL²/(8f) = 8.4×25²/8 ≈ 656 kN. Load, span and sag are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以非線性索網分析（考慮大變位）建立初始平衡形狀，再施加各荷載組合，檢查每根索的最大張力與最小張力，確認任何組合下都不會鬆弛；把桅桿軸力、拉索力與環梁反力和簡化手算比較，確認傳力路徑閉合。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Establish the initial equilibrium shape with a geometrically nonlinear cable-net analysis, then apply each load combination and check the maximum and minimum tension in every cable to confirm none goes slack in any combination; compare mast axial forces, stay forces and ring-beam reactions with simplified hand calculations to confirm the load path closes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 72 個區段平分圓周，半徑 r 處的徑向索間距 s = 2πr/72：r = 50 m 時約 4.4 m，r = 160 m 時約 14.0 m。若外緣一段徑向索受荷寬 14 m、荷載 0.6 kPa，w = 8.4 kN/m，吊點間跨距 L = 25 m、垂度 f = 1.0 m，水平張力 H = wL²/(8f) = 8.4×25²/8 ≈ 656 kN。荷載、跨距與垂度為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With 72 segments sharing the circumference, radial cable spacing at radius r is s = 2πr/72: about 4.4 m at r = 50 m and about 14.0 m at r = 160 m. If an outer radial cable carries a 14 m width at 0.6 kPa, w = 8.4 kN/m; with a span of L = 25 m between hanger points and sag f = 1.0 m, the horizontal tension is H = wL²/(8f) = 8.4×25²/8 ≈ 656 kN. Load, span and sag are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "A dome that is not a dome: net and mast system", which statement holds?
options: 索夾螺栓鎖緊一次就能永久維持夾緊力。
索網的預張力可以在完工後隨時用千斤頂任意調整。
72 個區段平分圓周，半徑 r 處的徑向索間距 s = 2πr/72：r = 50 m 時約 4.4 m，r = 160 m 時約 14.0 m。
optionsEn: Clamp bolts tightened once keep their clamping force forever.
Cable-net pretension can be adjusted freely with jacks at any time after completion.
With 72 segments sharing the circumference, radial cable spacing at radius r is s = 2πr/72: about 4.4 m at r = 50 m and about 14.0 m at r = 160 m.
quiz.explanation: 72 個區段平分圓周，半徑 r 處的徑向索間距 s = 2πr/72：r = 50 m 時約 4.4 m，r = 160 m 時約 14.0 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With 72 segments sharing the circumference, radial cable spacing at radius r is s = 2πr/72: about 4.4 m at r = 50 m and about 14.0 m at r = 160 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: A dome that is not a dome: net and mast system: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「徑向索網與 12 支桅桿」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Radial net and 12 masts” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以非線性索網分析（考慮大變位）建立初始平衡形狀，再施加各荷載組合，檢查每根索的最大張力與最小張力，確認任何組合下都不會鬆弛；把桅桿軸力、拉索力與環梁反力和簡化手算比較，確認傳力路徑閉合。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Establish the initial equilibrium shape with a geometrically nonlinear cable-net analysis, then apply each load combination and check the maximum and minimum tension in every cable to confirm none goes slack in any combination; compare mast axial forces, stay forces and ring-beam reactions with simplified hand calculations to confirm the load path closes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：索網結構的設計文件須以非線性分析為準，並列出每根索的設計張力範圍（最小與最大），作為施工張拉與日後檢測的依據；任何改變吊點或索長的變更都要重新做整體分析。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design documents for a cable net must be based on nonlinear analysis and list each cable's design tension range, minimum and maximum, as the basis for erection tensioning and later inspection; any change to hanger points or cable lengths requires a new global analysis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以線性分析設計索網會嚴重誤判內力，因為索網的勁度隨形狀與張力改變；若某一區段預張力不足，強風時索鬆弛、膜面拍打，荷載突然轉到相鄰索，引起連鎖過載或膜片撕裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing a cable net by linear analysis badly misjudges forces, because net stiffness changes with shape and tension; if one segment has too little pretension, its cables go slack in strong wind, the fabric flaps and load jumps to neighbouring cables, causing cascading overload or fabric tears. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以非線性索網分析（考慮大變位）建立初始平衡形狀，再施加各荷載組合，檢查每根索的最大張力與最小張力，確認任何組合下都不會鬆弛；把桅桿軸力、拉索力與環梁反力和簡化手算比較，確認傳力路徑閉合。
knowledge.textEn: Establish the initial equilibrium shape with a geometrically nonlinear cable-net analysis, then apply each load combination and check the maximum and minimum tension in every cable to confirm none goes slack in any combination; compare mast axial forces, stay forces and ring-beam reactions with simplified hand calculations to confirm the load path closes.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 索網結構的設計文件須以非線性分析為準，並列出每根索的設計張力範圍（最小與最大），作為施工張拉與日後檢測的依據；任何改變吊點或索長的變更都要重新做整體分析。
knowledge.textEn: Design documents for a cable net must be based on nonlinear analysis and list each cable's design tension range, minimum and maximum, as the basis for erection tensioning and later inspection; any change to hanger points or cable lengths requires a new global analysis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "A dome that is not a dome: net and mast system"?
options: 以非線性索網分析（考慮大變位）建立初始平衡形狀，再施加各荷載組合，檢查每根索的最大張力與最小張力，確認任何組合下都不會鬆弛。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
索網外觀形狀正確，就表示每根索的張力都符合設計。
optionsEn: Establish the initial equilibrium shape with a geometrically nonlinear cable-net analysis, then apply each load combination and check the maximum and minimum tension in every cable to confirm none goes slack in any combination.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the net looks the right shape, every cable's tension matches the design.
quiz.explanation: 以非線性索網分析（考慮大變位）建立初始平衡形狀，再施加各荷載組合，檢查每根索的最大張力與最小張力，確認任何組合下都不會鬆弛；把桅桿軸力、拉索力與環梁反力和簡化手算比較，確認傳力路徑閉合。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Establish the initial equilibrium shape with a geometrically nonlinear cable-net analysis, then apply each load combination and check the maximum and minimum tension in every cable to confirm none goes slack in any combination; compare mast axial forces, stay forces and ring-beam reactions with simplified hand calculations to confirm the load path closes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: A dome that is not a dome: net and mast system: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「徑向索網與 12 支桅桿」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Radial net and 12 masts” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以線性分析設計索網會嚴重誤判內力，因為索網的勁度隨形狀與張力改變；若某一區段預張力不足，強風時索鬆弛、膜面拍打，荷載突然轉到相鄰索，引起連鎖過載或膜片撕裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing a cable net by linear analysis badly misjudges forces, because net stiffness changes with shape and tension; if one segment has too little pretension, its cables go slack in strong wind, the fabric flaps and load jumps to neighbouring cables, causing cascading overload or fabric tears. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：與混凝土或鋼構穹頂不同，這種屋蓋沒有受壓殼面，形狀完全由索長、吊點位置與預張力決定，所以結構重量極輕，卻對荷載方向變化非常敏感。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Unlike a concrete or steel dome there is no compression shell; the shape is set entirely by cable lengths, hanger positions and pretension, so the structure is extremely light yet very sensitive to changes in load direction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「千禧巨蛋是一個由鋼骨撐起的半球形穹頂。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The Millennium Dome is a hemispherical dome held up by a steel frame." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以線性分析設計索網會嚴重誤判內力，因為索網的勁度隨形狀與張力改變；若某一區段預張力不足，強風時索鬆弛、膜面拍打，荷載突然轉到相鄰索，引起連鎖過載或膜片撕裂。
knowledge.textEn: Designing a cable net by linear analysis badly misjudges forces, because net stiffness changes with shape and tension; if one segment has too little pretension, its cables go slack in strong wind, the fabric flaps and load jumps to neighbouring cables, causing cascading overload or fabric tears.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "A dome that is not a dome: net and mast system" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
以線性分析設計索網會嚴重誤判內力，因為索網的勁度隨形狀與張力改變；若某一區段預張力不足，強風時索鬆弛、膜面拍打，荷載突然轉到相鄰索，引起連鎖過載或膜片撕裂。
屋頂越輕越安全，因為需要承擔的荷載越少。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Designing a cable net by linear analysis badly misjudges forces, because net stiffness changes with shape and tension.
The lighter a roof the safer it is, because it has less load to carry.
quiz.explanation: 以線性分析設計索網會嚴重誤判內力，因為索網的勁度隨形狀與張力改變；若某一區段預張力不足，強風時索鬆弛、膜面拍打，荷載突然轉到相鄰索，引起連鎖過載或膜片撕裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing a cable net by linear analysis badly misjudges forces, because net stiffness changes with shape and tension; if one segment has too little pretension, its cables go slack in strong wind, the fabric flaps and load jumps to neighbouring cables, causing cascading overload or fabric tears. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 輕屋蓋的荷載反轉：風吸力控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Load reversal on a light roof: wind uplift governs: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「比空氣還輕的屋頂」如何影響倫敦千禧巨蛋屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “A roof lighter than the air inside” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millennium Dome roof”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: Buro Happold 指出整個屋頂的重量比室內空氣還輕。重量輕意味著自重幾乎無法壓住屋面，風吹過低矮的穹形時在頂部與迎風前緣產生吸力，淨荷載方向由向下轉為向上。索網必須同時承受積雪等向下荷載與風吸力等向上荷載，兩種情況下都要保持受拉，因此需要相反曲率或壓制索提供向下的約束，再以預張力使網在兩個方向都有勁度。對輕屋蓋來說，吸力往往比雪載更控制設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「比空氣還輕的屋頂」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Buro Happold notes that the whole roof weighs less than the air inside the building. Low weight means self-weight can barely hold the roof down; wind over a low dome shape creates suction over the crown and windward edge, reversing the net load from downward to upward. The net must carry downward loads such as snow and upward loads such as suction while staying in tension in both, so tie-down cables or opposite curvature provide downward restraint and pretension gives the net stiffness in both directions. On a lightweight roof, suction often governs the design more than snow. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “A roof lighter than the air inside” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：室內容積約 2.2×10⁶ m³，空氣 1.2 kg/m³，空氣質量約 2,640 t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The enclosed volume of about 2.2×10⁶ m³ at 1.2 kg/m³ holds about 2,640 t of air.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「屋頂越輕越安全，因為需要承擔的荷載越少。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The lighter a roof the safer it is, because it has less load to carry." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「比空氣還輕的屋頂」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “A roof lighter than the air inside”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 輕屋蓋的荷載反轉：風吸力控制
knowledge.titleEn: Load reversal on a light roof: wind uplift governs
knowledge.text: Buro Happold 指出整個屋頂的重量比室內空氣還輕。重量輕意味著自重幾乎無法壓住屋面，風吹過低矮的穹形時在頂部與迎風前緣產生吸力，淨荷載方向由向下轉為向上。
knowledge.textEn: Buro Happold notes that the whole roof weighs less than the air inside the building. Low weight means self-weight can barely hold the roof down; wind over a low dome shape creates suction over the crown and windward edge, reversing the net load from downward to upward.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：屋頂越輕越安全，因為需要承擔的荷載越少。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The lighter a roof the safer it is, because it has less load to carry. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「輕屋蓋的荷載反轉：風吸力控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load reversal on a light roof: wind uplift governs" is correct?
options: 屋頂越輕越安全，因為需要承擔的荷載越少。
膜材越厚越強，所以應該儘量選厚膜並把它拉得越緊越好。
Buro Happold 指出整個屋頂的重量比室內空氣還輕。
optionsEn: The lighter a roof the safer it is, because it has less load to carry.
Thicker fabric is always stronger, so choose the thickest fabric and pull it as tight as possible.
Buro Happold notes that the whole roof weighs less than the air inside the building.
quiz.explanation: Buro Happold 指出整個屋頂的重量比室內空氣還輕。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Buro Happold notes that the whole roof weighs less than the air inside the building. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 輕屋蓋的荷載反轉：風吸力控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load reversal on a light roof: wind uplift governs: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「比空氣還輕的屋頂」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “A roof lighter than the air inside” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：室內容積約 2.2×10⁶ m³，空氣 1.2 kg/m³，空氣質量約 2,640 t。以直徑 320 m 的平面 π×160² ≈ 80,400 m² 計，屋頂重量上限約 2,640,000/80,400 ≈ 33 kg/m²，即約 0.32 kPa。若陣風速 35 m/s，q = ½ρV² ≈ 0.75 kPa，吸力係數 −1.0 時淨上揚約 0.75 − 0.32 ≈ 0.43 kPa。風速與係數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The enclosed volume of about 2.2×10⁶ m³ at 1.2 kg/m³ holds about 2,640 t of air. Over a 320 m diameter plan of π×160² ≈ 80,400 m², the roof weight is therefore below about 2,640,000/80,400 ≈ 33 kg/m², about 0.32 kPa. With a 35 m/s gust, q = ½ρV² ≈ 0.75 kPa, and a suction coefficient of −1.0 gives a net uplift of about 0.75 − 0.32 ≈ 0.43 kPa. Wind speed and coefficient are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：荷載組合表須包含「最小自重加最大吸力」與「最大自重加雪載」兩種極端，並以非線性分析檢查每根索、壓制索與地錨在兩者下的張力範圍；地錨與環梁要以上拔力為主要檢核項目，並確認基礎重量或樁抗拔力有足夠安全係數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The load-combination table must include both extremes, minimum self-weight with maximum suction and maximum self-weight with snow, and nonlinear analysis must check the tension range of every cable, tie-down and anchor in both; ground anchors and the ring beam must be checked primarily for uplift, confirming adequate safety factors from foundation weight or pile tension capacity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 室內容積約 2.2×10⁶ m³，空氣 1.2 kg/m³，空氣質量約 2,640 t。以直徑 320 m 的平面 π×160² ≈ 80,400 m² 計，屋頂重量上限約 2,640,000/80,400 ≈ 33 kg/m²，即約 0.32 kPa。若陣風速 35 m/s，q = ½ρV² ≈ 0.75 kPa，吸力係數 −1.0 時淨上揚約 0.75 − 0.32 ≈ 0.43 kPa。風速與係數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The enclosed volume of about 2.2×10⁶ m³ at 1.2 kg/m³ holds about 2,640 t of air. Over a 320 m diameter plan of π×160² ≈ 80,400 m², the roof weight is therefore below about 2,640,000/80,400 ≈ 33 kg/m², about 0.32 kPa. With a 35 m/s gust, q = ½ρV² ≈ 0.75 kPa, and a suction coefficient of −1.0 gives a net uplift of about 0.75 − 0.32 ≈ 0.43 kPa. Wind speed and coefficient are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「輕屋蓋的荷載反轉：風吸力控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load reversal on a light roof: wind uplift governs", which statement holds?
options: 室內容積約 2.2×10⁶ m³，空氣 1.2 kg/m³，空氣質量約 2,640 t。
索網的最終索力是由提升時絞車拉多大力決定的。
風洞模型只要幾何比例正確，量到的壓力就能直接用於實尺度。
optionsEn: The enclosed volume of about 2.2×10⁶ m³ at 1.2 kg/m³ holds about 2,640 t of air.
The final cable forces in a net are set by how hard the winches pull during lifting.
If the wind-tunnel model is geometrically correct, its pressures apply directly at full scale.
quiz.explanation: 室內容積約 2.2×10⁶ m³，空氣 1.2 kg/m³，空氣質量約 2,640 t。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The enclosed volume of about 2.2×10⁶ m³ at 1.2 kg/m³ holds about 2,640 t of air. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 輕屋蓋的荷載反轉：風吸力控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load reversal on a light roof: wind uplift governs: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「比空氣還輕的屋頂」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “A roof lighter than the air inside” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 荷載組合表須包含「最小自重加最大吸力」與「最大自重加雪載」兩種極端，並以非線性分析檢查每根索、壓制索與地錨在兩者下的張力範圍；地錨與環梁要以上拔力為主要檢核項目，並確認基礎重量或樁抗拔力有足夠安全係數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The load-combination table must include both extremes, minimum self-weight with maximum suction and maximum self-weight with snow, and nonlinear analysis must check the tension range of every cable, tie-down and anchor in both; ground anchors and the ring beam must be checked primarily for uplift, confirming adequate safety factors from foundation weight or pile tension capacity. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：輕屋蓋的設計基準要明確寫出最小自重的取值與吸力的來源（規範或風洞），並把地錨抗拔試驗列為施工停止點；完工後任何移除屋面配重或附屬物的計畫，都要回頭檢查上拔。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis of a light roof must state the minimum self-weight used and the source of suction values, code or wind tunnel, and make anchor pull-out tests a construction hold point; after completion any plan that removes roof weight or attachments must be rechecked for uplift.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以向下荷載設計而低估吸力，壓制索與地錨的拉力不足，強風時屋面上浮、索網形狀翻轉，膜片承受設計外的應力而大面積撕裂；輕量屋蓋的風損往往從邊緣與開口附近開始。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing only for downward load and underestimating suction leaves tie-downs and anchors short of capacity, so in strong wind the roof lifts, the net shape inverts and the fabric sees unintended stress and tears over large areas; wind damage to light roofs often starts at edges and openings. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 荷載組合表須包含「最小自重加最大吸力」與「最大自重加雪載」兩種極端，並以非線性分析檢查每根索、壓制索與地錨在兩者下的張力範圍；地錨與環梁要以上拔力為主要檢核項目，並確認基礎重量或樁抗拔力有足夠安全係數。
knowledge.textEn: The load-combination table must include both extremes, minimum self-weight with maximum suction and maximum self-weight with snow, and nonlinear analysis must check the tension range of every cable, tie-down and anchor in both; ground anchors and the ring beam must be checked primarily for uplift, confirming adequate safety factors from foundation weight or pile tension capacity.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 輕屋蓋的設計基準要明確寫出最小自重的取值與吸力的來源（規範或風洞），並把地錨抗拔試驗列為施工停止點；完工後任何移除屋面配重或附屬物的計畫，都要回頭檢查上拔。
knowledge.textEn: The design basis of a light roof must state the minimum self-weight used and the source of suction values, code or wind tunnel, and make anchor pull-out tests a construction hold point; after completion any plan that removes roof weight or attachments must be rechecked for uplift.

quiz.question: 要驗證「輕屋蓋的荷載反轉：風吸力控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Load reversal on a light roof: wind uplift governs"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
荷載組合表須包含「最小自重加最大吸力」與「最大自重加雪載」兩種極端，並以非線性分析檢查每根索、壓制索與地錨在兩者下的張力範圍。
PTFE 膜屋面是永久性的，不需要考慮更換。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

The load-combination table must include both extremes, minimum self-weight with maximum suction and maximum self-weight with snow, and nonlinear analysis must check the tension range of every cable, tie-down and anchor in both.
A PTFE membrane roof is permanent and never needs replacement planning.
quiz.explanation: 荷載組合表須包含「最小自重加最大吸力」與「最大自重加雪載」兩種極端，並以非線性分析檢查每根索、壓制索與地錨在兩者下的張力範圍；地錨與環梁要以上拔力為主要檢核項目，並確認基礎重量或樁抗拔力有足夠安全係數。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The load-combination table must include both extremes, minimum self-weight with maximum suction and maximum self-weight with snow, and nonlinear analysis must check the tension range of every cable, tie-down and anchor in both; ground anchors and the ring beam must be checked primarily for uplift, confirming adequate safety factors from foundation weight or pile tension capacity. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 輕屋蓋的荷載反轉：風吸力控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load reversal on a light roof: wind uplift governs: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「比空氣還輕的屋頂」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “A roof lighter than the air inside” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以向下荷載設計而低估吸力，壓制索與地錨的拉力不足，強風時屋面上浮、索網形狀翻轉，膜片承受設計外的應力而大面積撕裂；輕量屋蓋的風損往往從邊緣與開口附近開始。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing only for downward load and underestimating suction leaves tie-downs and anchors short of capacity, so in strong wind the roof lifts, the net shape inverts and the fabric sees unintended stress and tears over large areas; wind damage to light roofs often starts at edges and openings. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對輕屋蓋來說，吸力往往比雪載更控制設計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: On a lightweight roof, suction often governs the design more than snow.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「屋頂越輕越安全，因為需要承擔的荷載越少。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The lighter a roof the safer it is, because it has less load to carry." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只以向下荷載設計而低估吸力，壓制索與地錨的拉力不足，強風時屋面上浮、索網形狀翻轉，膜片承受設計外的應力而大面積撕裂；輕量屋蓋的風損往往從邊緣與開口附近開始。
knowledge.textEn: Designing only for downward load and underestimating suction leaves tie-downs and anchors short of capacity, so in strong wind the roof lifts, the net shape inverts and the fabric sees unintended stress and tears over large areas; wind damage to light roofs often starts at edges and openings.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「輕屋蓋的荷載反轉：風吸力控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load reversal on a light roof: wind uplift governs" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
膜材越厚越強，所以應該儘量選厚膜並把它拉得越緊越好。
若只以向下荷載設計而低估吸力，壓制索與地錨的拉力不足，強風時屋面上浮、索網形狀翻轉，膜片承受設計外的應力而大面積撕裂；輕量屋蓋的風損往往從邊緣與開口附近開始。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Thicker fabric is always stronger, so choose the thickest fabric and pull it as tight as possible.

Designing only for downward load and underestimating suction leaves tie-downs and anchors short of capacity, so in strong wind the roof lifts, the net shape inverts and the fabric sees unintended stress and tears over large areas.
quiz.explanation: 若只以向下荷載設計而低估吸力，壓制索與地錨的拉力不足，強風時屋面上浮、索網形狀翻轉，膜片承受設計外的應力而大面積撕裂；輕量屋蓋的風損往往從邊緣與開口附近開始。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing only for downward load and underestimating suction leaves tie-downs and anchors short of capacity, so in strong wind the roof lifts, the net shape inverts and the fabric sees unintended stress and tears over large areas; wind damage to light roofs often starts at edges and openings. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
